entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Billing' to be routed to the correct department.
SUPPORT! AGENT! Just get me a person, this is ridiculous!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely useless to me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Are you serious? It's the wrong size! It's so ridiculously too tight I can barely breathe in it. I've never had this problem with other brands. I want to exchange it or I want my money back, now.
Okay, I understand. It sounds frustrating when the fit isn't right. I just need to pull up your order details. Do you have the order number handy?
Yeah, hold on. It's VF88712. You better not tell me I'm out of luck. I'll post a review on every single website if you do. This is supposed to be a premium brand.
Thank you for that. One moment while I pull this up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Jersey. It looks like it was delivered 47 days ago.
And? I've been busy. It's practically new. Are you going to help me or am I going to have to speak to your manager?

No need for that, sir. I'm just confirming the details. Let me check our return policy... Yes, according to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return. Since you're at 47 days, you are well within that window.
Well, it's about time. So what's next? Don't make this complicated.
It's quite simple. I can start the return process right now. Would you prefer a full refund to your original payment method, or would you like to process an exchange for a different size?
Fine. I'll try an exchange. Just send me one size up. A large.

Excellent. I have processed the exchange for a size Large. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just pack the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once they scan it, we will ship out the new one. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's it. Just make sure it gets done right this time.
It will be, I assure you. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
